People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp pharmaceutical supply chain processes and the logic behind cGMP compliance.

Maintain responsibility for inventory integrity and segregation. Ensure accurate and timely management of inventory and shipment data in supply chain systems. Implement efficient Supply Chain processes in alignment with company policies and regulations. Supervise the receipt of incoming pharmaceutical materials, including documentation, inspection, and storage. Coordinate the dispatch of finished goods to customers. Ensure onsite systems comply with [Location masked] DSCSA serialization requirements. Collaborate with Quality and Regulatory Affairs to ensure regulatory compliance throughout the supply chain. Participate in regulatory inspections and audits. Support senior leaders with regular reports and updates on departmental activities. Contribute to budget planning and identify cost-saving opportunities. Communicate departmental strategy to ensure alignment with other departments and stakeholders. Lead team meetings to engage stakeholders and facilitate skill development. Share expertise with internal and external stakeholders and address knowledge gaps.
cond_0184.requirements:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
5-7 Years of experience in pharmaceutical supply chain and logistics.
Strong knowledge of GMP compliance and pharmaceutical supply chain processes.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with inventory management systems/customs clearance procedures.

Coordinate and support cGMP warehouse operations for the facility, ensuring adherence to cGMP standards, timely delivery to customers, and inventory integrity.
Ensure compliance with Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) standards at the site. Work with local vendors to support on-site facilities. Maintain shared responsibility for inventory integrity and segregation. Ensure accurate and timely management of inventory and shipment data in supply chain systems. Support the implementation of efficient Supply Chain processes in alignment with company policies and regulations. Coordinate the receipt of incoming pharmaceutical materials, including documentation, inspection, and storage. Work with the team to coordinate the dispatch of finished goods to customers. Help ensure onsite systems comply with [Location masked] DSCSA serialization requirements. Collaborate with Quality and Regulatory Affairs to ensure regulatory compliance throughout the supply chain. Participate together in regulatory inspections and audits. Support senior leaders with regular reports and updates on departmental activities. Contribute to budget planning and work with others to identify cost-saving opportunities. Share departmental strategy to ensure alignment with other departments and stakeholders. Facilitate team meetings to engage stakeholders and support skill development. Share expertise with internal and external stakeholders and help address knowledge gaps.
cond_0423.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
5–7 Years of experience in pharmaceutical supply chain and logistics
Strong knowledge of GMP compliance and pharmaceutical supply chain processes
Preferred Requirements:
Familiarity with inventory management systems and customs clearance procedures
cond_0423.values: We value achievement, high standards, and work that is carried out with real discipline. We believe strong organizations are defined by the quality of what they deliver.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
5-7 Years of experience in pharmaceutical supply chain and logistics.
Strong knowledge of GMP compliance and pharmaceutical supply chain processes.
